context: Extend the strict-base-refresh policy family with a new decision under _project/decisions/. Reuse pr-refresh as the intended one-at-a-time absorb. Explicitly reject treating allow_update_branch as automatic branch update, reject bulk auto-refresh (refresh storm), and reject arming auto-merge at pr-open as the fix for this class. Point implementers at 01 for the currency gate and 02 for the throughput measurement that is the only authority to recommend reopening 07a or 07b.
description: Write one decision record that restates the #1751 BEHIND diagnosis after adversarial review. The binding constraint is required-gate duration versus develop merge interarrival under a strict current-base lock. Opening a stale worktree made #1751 behind before it existed; auto-merge withhold and allow_update_branch did not cause that state. SHADOW_ONLY remains in force. This item does not change workflows, Makefile merge behavior, GitHub settings, or the blocked 07a/07b items.

anti_patterns.dont: Blame auto-merge withhold for PRs that were already behind at open
anti_patterns.instead: separate open-stale from post-green interarrival staleness
anti_patterns.why: counterfactual sufficiency: #1751 had no green-and-current window

anti_patterns.dont: Recommend updating every open develop PR when develop moves
anti_patterns.instead: refresh one stale PR at a time
anti_patterns.why: Makefile and policy already call multi-PR refresh self-defeating under strict checks

anti_patterns.dont: Treat allow_update_branch as automatic PR update
anti_patterns.instead: name the actual updater if one is later selected (merge queue or explicit pr-refresh)
anti_patterns.why: the GitHub field is the Update-branch suggestion affordance, not an updater

anti_patterns.dont: Unblock 07a or 07b from this policy item
anti_patterns.instead: leave 07a/07b blocked and send the measurement to behind-pr-occurrence-02
anti_patterns.why: 06 selected SHADOW_ONLY; 07a/07b stay blocked until a later measurement-backed activation

preserves.behavior: SHADOW_ONLY remains the selected refresh path until a later activation supersedes strict-base-refresh-06
make pr-ready remains the only local auto-merge arm path

prior_art.concept: pr-refresh exact merge and refresh-storm warning
arm auto-merge only when the branch is final
strict current-base lock and one-at-a-time pr-refresh shape
